title: Five physics closures and three outside-box probes: interacting fractional pair pumping, dynamical SU(3) quantum links, horizon scattering, spectral renormalization, a topological information engine, many-body scars, nonlinear metrology, and thermodynamic geometry
purpose: Execute the five physics targets following Passes 4081-4088 and add three independent outside-box constructions with exact finite-system checks and strict evidence boundaries.
result: An exact one-third-filled strong-coupling ground bundle has Chern number one and branch transport one third per cycle; a finite SU(3) quantum-link truncation has a unique one-link Gauss singlet, linear string energy, and exact two-state plaquette spectrum; a passive reciprocal hopping gradient obeys a decisive no-horizon and no-spontaneous-Hawking theorem; an 80-branch hierarchy realizes a discrete-scale fixed cycle with log-period-average spectral dimension four only when b=80^(1/4) is supplied; and a closed irrep-controlled topological information engine has zero maximum net work in the reversible limit. Three independent probes give an exact CDW scar trimer, qutrit-cat Fisher information scaling, and the canonical Fisher geometry of the dark reservoir.
coordination: Passes 4005-4096 and the authoritative long-form docs/index.html remain intact. Publication is through the ordered manifest, standalone page, protected theorem card, and idempotent frontier reconciler.
boundary: Exact finite strong-coupling, SU(3)-covariant quantum-link, Gauss-law, passive-Bogoliubov, hierarchical-spectrum, information-thermodynamic, invariant-subspace, quantum-Fisher, and canonical-geometry statements only. No fractional-pump experiment, continuum QCD, Hawking observation, physical four-dimensional spacetime, positive-work engine, generic scar phase, gravity, cosmology, or theory of everything is established.
